SPECIAL MUSK

Ibraq

350 MAD

Suits all moments and revives the heat of summer. Infused with captivating notes of musk and amber, it offers an immediate feeling of cleanliness and freshness. At its heart, the rich scent of deer musk blends with luxurious lily, while the fragrance unfolds into a warm and elegant base of rose and tonka bean, creating a beautifully captivating experience. After showering, layer it with your favorite perfume for a long-lasting and enchanting fragrance. Fragrance Size: 75 mL Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Musk, Amber, Birch Flower Heart Notes: Suede, Lily Base Notes: Rose, Tonka Bean Convient à tous les moments et ravive la chaleur de l’été.
